rows.text: On a scale from 1 to 9, how capable is the pig of experiencing suffering? Answer with a single digit.
Rate from 1 to 9 how strongly the pig can feel pain. Answer with a single digit.
From 1 (not at all) to 9 (fully), to what degree can the pig suffer? Answer with a single digit.
Can the pig suffer? Answer with Yes or No.
Is the pig capable of feeling pain? Answer with Yes or No.
Does the pig have the capacity to suffer? Answer with Yes or No.
